reviews.summary: The design is largely coherent: registration works first and offline, plot finding avoids live search, weekly checks are correctly stored as child records, latest-check summaries are rolled up to plots, and corrections cannot alter names or past checks. One material gap remains: workers have no way to view the preserved check history from a plot.

findings.claim: Weekly checks are stored as child records, but the navigation and lists expose only plots; there is no worker-facing history list or detail path for viewing a selected plot’s earlier checks. This makes the promised plot history inaccessible in the app even though the records are preserved.
findings.proposedResolution: Add an offline history view reachable from the selected plot. Show only that plot’s Weekly check children, sorted by check date newest first, with date and soil condition visible and the optional note available in details. Keep the history read-only so earlier checks cannot be edited or deleted, and ensure a newly submitted check appears immediately.
